### `class ClientTalkingState` — `fabric/src/main/java/villager_voices/fabric/compat/ClientTalkingState.java`
The client's own synced TalkingState instance — the same class the fabric server module holds its own authoritative instance of (docs/spec/domains/compat.md COMPAT-REQ-002's own Javadoc), kept current by TalkingClientNetworking's TalkingPayload receiver and read once per frame by VillagerTalkingRenderStateMixin/ ZombieVillagerTalkingRenderStateMixin.

### `class EmfCompat` — `fabric/src/main/java/villager_voices/fabric/compat/EmfCompat.java`
The soft-dependency half of VV-12 (docs/spec/domains/compat.md COMPAT-REQ-004): exposes villager_voices.is_talking to EMF via EMFAnimationApi.registerUniqueAnimationVariableFactory(String, String, UniqueVariableFactory) — reading it back from the exact same TalkingRenderState#IS_TALKING render-state entry VillagerTalkingRenderStateMixin/ ZombieVillagerTalkingRenderStateMixin already copied it into (COMPAT-DEC-001: one copy, one reader, never a second parallel lookup), via EMFState.state() — EMF's own duck-interface over the very same EntityRenderState instance Fabric API's FabricRenderState is mixed into, both present on one object during the animation pass.
- `String VARIABLE_ID` — The fully-dotted variable id a compatible animation's query.variable(...) names.
- `void register()` — Registers #VARIABLE_ID against EMF.

### `class TalkingClientNetworking` — `fabric/src/main/java/villager_voices/fabric/compat/TalkingClientNetworking.java`
The client half of VV-12's sync (docs/spec/domains/compat.md COMPAT-REQ-002): receives TalkingPayload and applies it to ClientTalkingState#instance(), converting the payload's own relative ticks into an absolute untilTick against the client's own clock (ClientLevel#getGameTime()) — the two servers' and clients' tick counters are not synchronised, so only a relative duration crosses the wire, matching TalkingPayload's own Javadoc.
- `void register()`

### `record TalkingPayload(UUID villagerId, int ticks)` — `fabric/src/main/java/villager_voices/fabric/compat/TalkingPayload.java`
villager_voices:talking — VV-12's own S2C sync (docs/spec/domains/compat.md COMPAT-REQ-002/COMPAT-REQ-003): the server side of a played reaction line's talking-state mark, sent once per line per player in range (never per tick), carrying villagerId (this codebase's own identity scheme throughout, villager_voices.LineSink#show — not a raw entity network id, deliberately, this ticket's own Findings) and ticks, the duration from the moment the client applies it (not an absolute server tick, since the two clocks are not synchronised) for ClientTalkingState's own startTalking call.
- `Type<TalkingPayload> TYPE`
- `StreamCodec<ByteBuf, TalkingPayload> STREAM_CODEC`
- `Type<? extends CustomPacketPayload> type()`

### `interface TalkingPayloadSender` — `fabric/src/main/java/villager_voices/fabric/compat/TalkingPayloadSender.java`
The one seam TalkingStateSync sends a TalkingPayload through — production wires ServerPlayNetworking::send (its own default constructor); a game test substitutes a capturing implementation instead, since a GameTestHelper's mock players are not real network-connected clients a sent payload could otherwise be observed arriving at (this ticket's own "capture through a seam" test note).
- `void send(ServerPlayer player, TalkingPayload payload)`

### `class TalkingRenderState` — `fabric/src/main/java/villager_voices/fabric/compat/TalkingRenderState.java`
The one RenderStateDataKey VV-12 copies the talking-state flag through (docs/spec/domains/ compat.md COMPAT-REQ-003, ARCH-DEC-004: the render-state side channel, never a custom EntityRenderState subclass) — written by VillagerTalkingRenderStateMixin/ZombieVillagerTalkingRenderStateMixin at extractRenderState's own TAIL, read back by EmfCompat's registered variable factory from that same per-frame render-state instance.
- `RenderStateDataKey<Boolean> IS_TALKING`

### `class TalkingStateSync` — `fabric/src/main/java/villager_voices/fabric/compat/TalkingStateSync.java`
The server-authoritative half of VV-12's talking-state sync (docs/spec/domains/compat.md COMPAT-REQ-002): marks #talkingState()'s own TalkingState when a line plays and sends TalkingPayload to every candidate player still in the display's own hearing range — the same display.hearingRangeBlocks filter villager_voices.fabric.sound.FabricLineSink already applies to the action-bar text, applied again here independently, since the talking-state visual cue is not gated behind display.actionBar (a player with the action bar off should still see mouth movement).
- `TalkingStateSync()` — Production wiring: sends for real, via Fabric's own S2C networking API.
- `TalkingStateSync(TalkingPayloadSender sender)`
- `TalkingState talkingState()` — The server's own authoritative instance — queryable directly by a test, never by a client.
- `void markTalking(MinecraftServer server, ServerLevel level, UUID villagerId, Vec3 pos, Set<UUID> playerIds, Config config, long now)` — Marks villagerId talking through now + config.talkingDurationTicks() and sends TalkingPayload to every player in playerIds within hearing range of pos in level.
